run_generation_benchmark: run generation benchmarks for OPT models like 125m, 1.3b, or 66b using --model_name
download_model_checkpoint: download an OPT model checkpoint and dependencies by model name such as 13b or 30b
measure_generation_throughput: measure words per second generation throughput for a given OPT model checkpoint
setup_gpt2_tokenizer: setup a GPT2 tokenizer from vocab and merges files in a given model path
cleanup_benchmark_data: cleanup downloaded dependencies directory and tar.gz file after benchmarking is complete
